description_en: Creates a tracking task. After you create a tracking task, the system sends operations reports to you by email on a regular basis
description_zh: 调用CreateCdnDeliverTask创建报表订阅任务，订阅成功后系统会周期性地以邮件方式向您发送报表统计数据
name: CreateCdnDeliverTask

parameters.help_en: The name of the tracking task
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The operations reports that are tracked by the task. The data must be escaped in JSON
parameters.help_zh: 待订阅的报表列表，需进行JSON转义
parameters.name: reports

parameters.help_en:
The domain names to be tracked. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,). You can specify up to 500 domain names. If you want to specify more than 500 domain names, submit a ticket (https://workorder-intl.console.aliyun.com/?spm=5176.2020520001.aliyun_topbar.18.dbd44bd3e4f845#/ticket/createIndex).

If you do not specify a domain name, the tracking task is created for all domain names that belong to your Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.help_zh:
<props="china">待订阅的域名列表，多个域名用半角逗号（,）分隔，订阅域名数量上限为500个，超过500个请填写信息 (https://page.aliyun.com/form/act2017566026/index.htm)申请。</props>

<props="intl">待订阅的域名列表，多个域名用半角逗号（,）分隔，订阅域名数量上限为500个，超过500个请提交工单 (https://workorder-intl.console.aliyun.com/?spm=5176.2020520001.aliyun_topbar.18.dbd44bd3e4f845#/ticket/createIndex)申请。</props>
不传该参数，默认为账号下的所有域名订阅报表交付任务
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The method that is used to send operations reports. Operations reports are sent to you only by email. The settings must be escaped in JSON
parameters.help_zh: 报表发送方式，仅支持邮件发送，需进行JSON转义
parameters.name: deliver

parameters.help_en: The parameters that specify the time interval at which the tracking task sends operations reports. The settings must be escaped in JSON
parameters.help_zh: 订阅周期相关参数，需进行JSON转义
parameters.name: schedule

DeliverId.description_en: The ID of the tracking task
